health_verdict.headline: Training is progressing strongly (+1.475%/100ep destruction slope, 84.34% mean destruction, 38.0% 3-star rate) after the Cycle 5 milestone boost, though Critic calibration lag (|V(s0)-R|=46.12, EV=0.2574) and an 8% dip in TH18 2-star consistency (86.0%) warrant targeted stabilization.
health_verdict.progression_summary: Over the last 3,456 episodes (Ep 5,208 to 8,664), mean 50-episode destruction surged by +10.76% to 84.34% (+/-16.23%) and the 3-star triple rate climbed +26.0% to 38.0% (with P(3*|2*) = 44.2% and a 22.0% near-miss 85-99% rate). reasons.title: Critic Value Baseline Lag & High Gradient Norm After Milestone Reward Expansion
reasons.symptom: calibration_gap = -46.12 (critic_v_s0 = 45.65 vs mean_reward_50 = 91.77), explained_variance_50 = 0.2574 (delta = -0.3506 in Cycle 5), grad_norm_50 = 220.10, kl_saturation_rate_pct = 48.0%.
reasons.root_cause: The Cycle 5 addition of high-destruction milestones (+6.5 at 75%, +8.0 at 90%, +10.0 triple wipe) shifted empirical episode return faster than the value head could track under critic_lr_mult = 3.4 and vf_coef = 0.6, inflating GAE advantage magnitudes and causing 48% of PPO updates to hit the target_kl = 0.03 barrier.

reasons.title: TH18 Core Breach Regression on Offset Diamond (Hot Candle)
reasons.symptom: two_star_th_rate_50 dropped -8.0% to 86.0%, worst_village Offset Diamond (Hot Candle) lags at 79.4% mean destruction (13.2% triple rate vs 27.6% on Anti-Hydra Air Ring), inter_village_gap_pct = 11.1%, and tile_xy head saturation is 98.0% with top5_tile_mass_pct = 12.17%.
reasons.root_cause: Strong outer/mid-percentage milestone rewards encouraged broader perimeter clearing to hit 75%/90% thresholds, slightly diluting the spatial policy's commitment to the asymmetric TH18 compartment and Hot Candle multi-flame threat zone when FiLM conditioning (film_cond_scale = 0.72) and TH breach priors (th_threat_weight = 7.8) are not proportionally amplified.

reasons.title: High 85-99% Near-Miss Rate & Pacing Overhead
reasons.symptom: near_miss_85_to_99_pct_rate = 22.0%, p_3star_given_2star_pct = 44.2%, mean_noop_pct_50 = 15.43% (delta = +9.06% in Cycle 5).
reasons.root_cause: Increased waiting/NoOp actions (15.43%) improved spell timing for the main push (+26% triples), but noisy late-trajectory GAE advantages from an under-calibrated critic degrade fine-grained back-end spell and royal champion deployment timing during the final 85-99% cleanup phase.
